title: Detailed top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hatBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3b2a55'/>
      <stop offset='0.45' stop-color='#6b4c9a'/>
      <stop offset='0.6' stop-color='#8a63c4'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3b2a55'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='brimGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8a63c4'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#5a3f86'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2e1f45'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5f7e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c72b52'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='40' ry='10' fill='#2e1f45'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='40' ry='10' fill='url(#brimGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='40' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#a97fe0' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- crown -->
  <path d='M22 72 L24 26 Q50 20 76 26 L78 72 Q50 80 22 72 Z' fill='url(#hatBody)'/>
  <!-- crown shine -->
  <path d='M30 30 L32 66 Q34 68 37 68 L35 30 Z' fill='#b28ce8' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- top highlight -->
  <path d='M24 26 Q50 20 76 26 Q50 23 24 26 Z' fill='#c9a8f5'/>

  <!-- band -->
  <path d='M23 62 L77 62 L77.6 70 Q50 77 22.4 70 Z' fill='url(#bandGrad)'/>
  <!-- band shine -->
  <path d='M28 63 L31 63 L30.6 68 L27.6 68 Z' fill='#ffb0c1' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- band buckle -->
  <rect x='43' y='61.5' width='14' height='11' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2.2'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='61.5' width='5' height='11' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- crown lower edge shade -->
  <path d='M22.4 70 Q50 77 77.6 70 L78 72 Q50 80 22 72 Z' fill='#1f1433' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
